Step 1. Use the quotient identity for the tangent or cotangent and the reciprocal identity for the secant or cosecant so that everything is written in terms of sine and cosine.

\frac{\cos t}{\sin t} \cdot \sin t \cdot \sec t

Step 2. Use the reciprocal identity to rewrite the secant or cosecant in terms of sine and cosine: \sec t=\frac{1}{\cos t} and \csc t=\frac{1}{\sin t}.

\cos t \cdot \frac{1}{\cos t}

Step 3. Cancel the common factor in the numerator and denominator.

Therefore the simplified expression is \boxed{1}.

Therefore the simplified expression is \boxed{\cos x}.
